evals.prompt: Bake sale for the school library. Audience: parents and neighbours. Saturday 13 June, 09:00 to 13:00, school main hall. All proceeds go to new library books. Flyer, US Letter. No price, contact or brand assets supplied.
expect: Headings appear in the order defined by the output contract
Copy deck has a Budget and Count column for every block
Every Count is at or below its Budget, or the status is trimmed
Date, time and place match the prompt exactly
No price, contact or brand colour is invented
Exactly two layout options with different anchors
Contrast line says colours not supplied
Open questions name price, contact and brand colours
